reuse.why: Uses the shared isSkippedWeekendOccurrence and applyWeekendRule from shared/schedules.ts that getUpcomingDates and the budget template already use, plus recurConfigToRSchedule and dayFromDate.

duplication.why: The weekend rule is not repeated; only the small RSchedule construction and try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper mirror getUpcomingDates, as handlers in this file do.

placement.why: A new handler in server/schedules/app.ts beside schedule/get-upcoming-dates, with the rule left in the shared module.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Any change to the weekend rule reaches this handler through the shared helpers; the ±3 day window is commented with its reason.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange calls isSkippedWeekendOccurrence and applyWeekendRule rather than testing skipWeekend/frequency itself.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the weekend decision comes from the shared helpers.
